scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "NEXT,API,SYNC" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:listener"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:listener
scripts.setup: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../listener && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.db:init: cd backend && python -c "from app.database import init_db; import asyncio; asyncio.run(init_db())"
